traducciones.CONSENTIMIENTO INFORMADO PARA LA PARTICI: INFORMED CONSENT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE FAMILY TREATMENT PROGRAMME FOR FAMILIES WITH CHILDREN AT RISK OR IN NEED OF PROTECTION. RISK SUBPROGRAMME
INFORMED CONSENT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE FAMILY TREATMENT PROGRAMME FOR FAMILIES WITH CHILDREN AT RISK OR IN NEED OF PROTECTION. REUNIFICATION SUBPROGRAMME
traducciones.Este documento sirve para que el represe: This document allows the legal representative or representatives, where applicable, and children aged twelve or over to give their consent to participate in this programme voluntarily. The processing of a child’s personal data may be based on the child’s consent only when the child is over fourteen.
traducciones.En qué consiste este programa y para qué: What this programme involves and what it is for
traducciones.La finalidad de este programa es garanti: This programme aims to safeguard the rights of children and adolescents, promote their overall development and well-being, and provide families with focused, coordinated support that helps children remain in their family home. Its objectives are:

This programme aims to safeguard the rights of children and adolescents, promote their overall development and well-being, and provide families with focused, coordinated support to reunite children with their family of origin. Its objectives are:
traducciones.Potenciar los factores de protección y e: Strengthen protective factors and remove or reduce risk factors linked to a child being at risk or in need of protection.
traducciones.Capacitar a las familias para asegurar u: Help families build healthy family relationships that provide a safe, protective environment and prevent violence.
traducciones.Adquirir y fortalecer las competencias n: Develop and strengthen the skills parents or guardians need to care for children in a positive and responsible way.
traducciones.Promover, mejorar y recuperar el ajuste: Promote, improve and restore children’s personal adjustment and healthy development, supporting their integration into family, education and society.
traducciones.Facilitar las condiciones necesarias par: Create the conditions needed for reunification, with the involvement of all relevant people, organisations and services.
traducciones.Reducir y/o eliminar las causas y proble: Reduce or remove the causes and problems that led to the protective measure, so the family environment is safe, protective and free from violence.
traducciones.Adquirir y fortalecer las competencias n: Develop and strengthen the skills parents or guardians need to take on the parental role in a positive and responsible way.
traducciones.Promover, mejorar y recuperar el ajuste: Promote, improve and restore children’s personal adjustment and healthy development.
traducciones.Facilitar el proceso de transición para: Support the child’s transition and adjustment to the family, education and social environment they will join.
traducciones.Para ello, en primer lugar, se realizará: First, the family’s social situation will be assessed by collecting enough relevant information to understand family relationships, each person’s strengths and abilities, and their needs and difficulties. Information may be collected over more than one session.
traducciones.Tras esta evaluación, el equipo técnico: Following this assessment, the technical team will prepare a family support plan. It will set out proposed areas for improvement for the child or children and the family, together with the working methods. The plan will be agreed with the family, not imposed, and participation may be ended whenever the family chooses.
traducciones.Posteriormente, tendrá lugar la interven: The family support work will then begin. Depending on each family’s circumstances and needs, sessions may be held with children and adolescents, parents, the people responsible for their care, or the whole family. The programme may also offer group sessions for parents, children and adolescents, either separately or with all family members together.

The family support work will then begin. Depending on each family’s circumstances and needs, sessions may be held with children and adolescents, parents, the people responsible for their care, or the whole family. The programme may also offer group sessions for parents, children and adolescents, either separately or with all family members together.
traducciones.Durante la intervención se realizará un: The work will be reviewed to assess progress and identify any new needs. At the end, a final assessment will record the progress made and will be discussed with you in a feedback session. Four to six months after the work ends, the team will hold a follow-up interview to review the family’s situation in relation to the initial concerns and agreed objectives.
traducciones.Los datos obtenidos, así como los inform: Information collected, progress and final reports, and other documents produced during the work with the family may be sent to the competent public authority or service for children, social services or education, where this is necessary to carry out the programme’s objectives and within its scope. For statistical use, the organisation will handle the information and documents under its confidentiality obligation.
traducciones.Todo ello se llevará a cabo bajo la norm: All of this will be carried out under the applicable personal data protection laws, in particular Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation), and Organic Law 3/2018 of 5 December on Personal Data Protection and the Guarantee of Digital Rights. Data will be processed for the purposes and objectives set out in the preventive programme and within its scope.
traducciones.Si lo desea, podrá revocar en cualquier: You may withdraw this consent at any time and exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, data portability, restriction or objection by contacting the local organisation at ____________________. You may also lodge a complaint with the Andalusian Transparency and Data Protection Council, as explained at https://juntadeandalucia.es/protecciondedatos.html, or contact the Data Protection Officer of that local organisation at ____________________.
traducciones.La Delegación Territorial de la Consejer: La Territorial Delegation of the Regional Ministry of Social Inclusion, Youth, Families and Equality, through its Prevention Service, is the public body responsible for coordinating and monitoring the Family Treatment Programme for families with children at risk or in need of protection. The local organisation responsible for delivering it is ____________________.
traducciones.Los datos de contacto de dicha entidad l: Contact details for the local organisation: ____________________.
traducciones.El/la indicar entidad local que correspo: The local organisation ____________________ is the controller of the personal data processed in the programme.
traducciones.OTRAS CUESTIONES PARA LAS QUE LE PEDIMOS: OTHER MATTERS FOR WHICH WE ASK FOR YOUR CONSENT
traducciones.En ocasiones, solo si es necesario y en: When necessary and within the scope of the programme, certain additional activities may take place alongside the support work. These also require your consent:
traducciones.En ocasiones, y solo si es necesario y e: When necessary and within the scope of the programme, certain additional activities may take place alongside the support work. These also require your consent:
traducciones.Solicitar información a otros/as profesi: Request information from other professionals to support the work as effectively as possible.
traducciones.Registrar mediante medios audio-visuales: Make audio or video recordings of interviews or sessions so that the information collected is as complete as possible or can be used later.
traducciones.Remitir la información recabada en las e: Send information collected in assessments, or other documents produced during the work with the family, to research teams appointed by the organisation responsible for the programme for evaluation. For statistical use, the organisation will handle the information and documents under its confidentiality obligation.

Send information collected in assessments, or other documents produced during the work with the family, to research teams appointed by the organisation responsible for the programme for evaluation. For statistical use, the information and documents will be handled under the confidentiality obligation.
traducciones.Afirmo que he sido informado/a de las ca: I confirm that I have been informed about the programme and had the opportunity to ask questions about the support work. I have received satisfactory answers and enough information. I have also been informed that participation is voluntary and includes assessments of progress at different stages.

I confirm that I have been informed about the programme and had the opportunity to ask questions about the support work. I have received satisfactory answers and enough information. I have also been informed that participation is voluntary and includes assessments of progress at different stages.
traducciones.También he recibido información de forma: I have also received clear, precise and sufficient information about the protection of my personal data. I have been told that it will be processed and safeguarded with respect for my privacy and in accordance with applicable law.
traducciones.Declaro que he leído y conozco el conten: I declare that I have read and understood this document, understand the commitments I am making and expressly accept them. I therefore sign this informed consent, which I may request and consult in the future. By signing, I do not waive any of my rights.

traducciones.El Programa de Tratamiento a Familias en: The Family Treatment Programme for families at risk or in need of protection supports families who need help with their responsibilities as parents, so their children can grow and thrive within their families. Your family has agreed to take part, and you also need to decide whether to participate. If you agree, tick the options below and sign. You can ask any questions before or after making your decision.
